# Horde 40-60: Balanced and Speedrun (Orion research)

**Monolith source:** `research/catalog/horde-40-60.route.json`. Sub-packs in `packs/` are generated by `web/scripts/split-pack.ts` from `research/splits/horde-40-60.json`. Edit the monolith, then re-split. Do not re-run `research/horde-40-60/tools/build.py`.

The monolith is a route pack in **route schema v2** (`contracts/route-v2.schema.json`). It holds the steps, a `classProfessions` block for all 9 classes (Paladin included) and a `tipsMatrix` (class → role → tips). 36 Riverglades prefix steps before `h4060:badlands:a1419` are owned by 20-40 pack 07 (`appendFrom` until that id).

  `content/questie-db/` itself is **not** committed on this branch; the route only references its ids.
- WoW Forever findings: see [`../wow-forever.md`](../wow-forever.md).

## Outdoor order

Solo by default. Elites and group quests are optional or balanced-only (`tags.optional` and/or `routes: ["balanced"]`), with elite tips. Dungeons appear only when **Include dungeons** is on.

From `research/levels-40-60.md`: Riverglades (Rog'mar, Powderfuse, Bolder'ok non-elite, Eastsea) → Riverglades finish and Shen'dralas (pylons; Mana Mania optional/balanced) with the Powderfuse ↔ Steamwheedle ferry → Tanaris pass 1 and Camp Mojache / Feralas → Tanaris pass 2 and Hinterlands coast (Jintha'Alor optional/balanced) → Searing Gorge and Un'Goro → Felwood and expanded Azshara outdoor → Winterspring / Everlook then Western and Eastern Plaguelands (non-elite) → Mount Hyjal via Darkwhisper Gorge. Arathi, Hillsbrad, and Dustwallow are dropped or heavily trimmed. Hyjal demon elites, Plaguelands named elites, and Winterspring named elites stay optional or balanced. Silithus and an owlbeast grind only if the XP sim still needs them. There is no Horde flight master at Tainted Foothills or Summit of Eternity in Questie.

## Dungeons (Include dungeons only)

Authored in `research/dungeons/` and spliced from `research/dungeons/integration-plan.json` `afterStepId` anchors. Not 14 in-route placeholders.

Included on this band: Krol'dok Stronghold, Zul'Farrak including Gahz'rilla (2770), Maraudon, Alcaz Prison, Sunken Temple, Blackrock Depths, Blackmaw Hold (balanced and speedrun, shared Azshara `fly-3f5199`), Shaper's Terrace. Dire Maul East stays dropped because steps-v2 has no East-only run. `speedrun.replaces` for these 40-60 dungeons is still empty.

## Hearth and flight paths

**Home:** `h4060:tanaris:home-gadgetzan`, `h4060:feralas:home-mojache`, `h4060:the-hinterlands:home-revantusk`, `h4060:winterspring:home-everlook`.

**Flight path:** `h4060:tanaris:fp-gadgetzan`, `h4060:feralas:fp-mojache`, `h4060:the-hinterlands:fp-revantusk`, `h4060:searing-gorge:fp-thorium`, `h4060:un-goro-crater:fp-marshals`, `h4060:felwood:fp-bloodvenom`, `h4060:azshara:fp-valormok`, `h4060:winterspring:fp-everlook`, `h4060:eastern-plaguelands:fp-lights-hope`, `h4060:silithus:fp-cenarion-hold`.

No Tainted Foothills or Summit of Eternity FP steps (not in Questie). No Undercity `type:home` step: the only 40-60 travel that mentions Undercity before the plaguelands is `h4060:feralas:fly-2a22b8` (lands at Revantusk, then immediately `home-revantusk`). Tip on `h4060:western-plaguelands:a5093`: set your hearth in Undercity before the Bulwark if you have not already. Innkeeper Norman (6741) is in Questie.

## Level model (how the route was ordered)

These bullets describe the original `tools/levelsim.py` ordering; the live solo-first order is the Outdoor order section above (Arathi, Hillsbrad, and Dustwallow were removed except Stinky's Escape a1270). Do not re-run `build.py`; later solo-first edits sit on top of that generate.

`tools/levelsim.py` walks each route step by step from the 20-40 hand-off level (balanced **39.6**, speedrun **37.6**, the arrival at Rog'mar modelled in the 20-40 README of PR #29; #27 used 38.0 / 34.5):
- **Quest XP:** the `xp` value in `content/questie-db/quests.json`, with the Classic reduction for quests well below the player (full up to 5 levels below, then 80/60/40/20%, then 10%).
- **Kill XP (modest estimate):** for each objective step, the counts in the objective text (or 6 if none), times 1.5 for items that must drop, capped at 40, plus 4 mobs on the way;
  each kill is worth the Classic same-level value `5 x level + 45`, scaled down for lower mobs and up a little for higher ones. Dungeons give nothing in the model.
- **Level table:** Classic Era XP per level (WoW Forever has not published a different curve).
- **Rule:** never accept a quest more than 2 levels above the model level on balanced, 3 on speedrun. `tools/grind.py` finds the first accept that breaks the rule and inserts a
  grind step before it, at the camp in that zone (from `content/questie-db/npcs.json` spawns: hostile, non-elite, at least 6 spawns, levels around the player) until the player
  reaches the level of the next quests minus the margin. Minutes assume 2.5 kills per minute. Grind steps on Forever mobs are `verified: false`.
- The opening was reordered so lower-level quests come first: Riverglades quests up to 40, then Badlands, Swamp of Sorrows and Stranglethorn (now ours: 193, 570, 585, 698, 1393,
  1420...), then the Riverglades quests above 40, then (balanced) Arathi, Hillsbrad and Dustwallow (1168-1172), a leg removed in the 2026-11-22 solo pass. Prerequisite order and accept-before-turn-in hold on both routes.
- On speedrun, the plain (non-elite, non-crafting, non-escort) balanced quests at the opening hubs were moved onto the speedrun line, because they are cheaper than the grind. Since the second pass the same is done in the later zones the speedrun line already visits, for quests whose giver and hand-in both stand in that zone and whose level is inside the zone band (2605, 2822, 3561, 3601, 3881, 4296, 4301, 5534, 5863, 6162, 6164, 7815, 8460 were added this way). Full list:
  209, 573, 593, 600, 606, 607, 608, 609, 617, 710, 713, 1427, 1428, 2605, 2822, 3561, 3601, 3881, 4296, 4301, 5534, 5863, 6162, 6164, 7815, 8460, 95122, 95123, 95124, 95165, 97884.
- Balanced quests of level 55+ that sat far below their level moved to second visits after Mount Hyjal (Winterspring 969, Eastern Plaguelands 6133, Azshara 91611) or after Silithus
  (Tanaris 84135, 84137, 84138, 96912). Whiskey Slim's Lost Grog (580, level 50) is now a note in Stranglethorn instead of an accept.
- Prerequisite fixes from the official checker (PR #22): Keep An Eye Out (576) and Up to Snuff (587) are now taken after The Bloodsail Buccaneers (597) is handed in;
  Zukk'ash Report (7732) is handed in at Orgrimmar after Azshara instead of after Feralas, so March of the Silithid (4494, level 50) can be taken there and handed to
  Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan before Bungle in the Jungle (4496); Split Bone Necklace (598) stays balanced-only because it needs 596 from the balanced 20-40 line.
- Result: both routes reach 60 with no accept above the margin.
  Step-minute totals (dungeon and dungeons-off alternatives both counted, as in every pack): balanced 4532, speedrun 4294; on the dungeons-off path
  (dungeons give no XP in the model) balanced 3902, speedrun 3709. The speedrun saving comes from skipping elites, escorts, city legs and
  the level-60 revisits.
- Dungeon unlock (ordering only): Sunken Temple now comes after Larion and Muigin (4145) in Un'Goro, Blackrock Spire after Chillwind Horns (4809) in Winterspring,
  and Stratholme after the Light's Hope turn-ins (5542-5544, 6022) in Eastern Plaguelands, so the build's prerequisite guard keeps 4146/4147, the 4810 chain
  (4734, 4735, 4907, 5522, 5531, 4771) and the 5742 chain (5781, 5845, 5846, 5848). Step ids are unchanged. Still skipped: 6135/6163 (need 6042, which is not on this route,
  and 6133, which is a level-60 revisit), 3443 on speedrun (3442 is balanced-only), 3444/3446/3447 (3380/3445 not routed), 8412/8413 (Shaman class quests), and the Alcaz 95454 chain.
  The live splice is `research/dungeons/integration-plan.json`, not those in-route placeholders.
- Rebuild: `cd tools && python3 build.py && python3 emit.py && python3 simreport.py` (build creates `out/`). `db.py`/`build.py` still read the QuestieDB
  Forever dump from `/workspace/qdbf` and the PR #5 copy from `/workspace/r4060/pr5`; point those at your copies first. Regenerating overwrites the gotos added by `research/gotos/backfill.py`, so re-run it afterwards.

There is no kill-grind table on this pack. In the isolated enter-at-40 sim, quest turn-ins carry both balanced and speedrun to 60. `horde-40-60.route.json` has no `type: xp` action. `h4060:mount-hyjal:grind-speedrun-to-60` is a no-XP goto so dungeon plans can still anchor on it.

## How the Forever quests were placed

`auto.py` takes every Forever-new quest from PR #5 (`content/questie-db/quests.json` at 2e40dbf, `forever: true` and `foreverConfidence: "high"`; 79953 and 81951 are never routed) for the zone and level band, drops class quests, dungeon
quests, repeatables and Alliance-only quests, and pulls in Forever lead-in quests from other zones (Hyjal: Moonglade, Winterspring, Thousand Needles;
Shen'dralas: Desolace). It then walks the hubs greedily: go to the nearest giver with open quests, take everything there, do the objectives in
nearest-first order, hand in nearest-first, repeat until nothing opens. Elite quests and any follow-ups that need them are balanced-only. Quests whose
prerequisite is outside our data (a dungeon quest, or a quest PR #5 does not have) are left out; 15 were dropped this way (Shen'dralas Bristleback chain,
Azshara Sin'dorei chain that needs Classic "Betrayed", Riverglades "Key Ingredients", Tanaris none). The order is a data-driven draft, not a tested route.

### Riverglades 94532 / 94535 (added after the 20-40 hand-off)

Gnoll Infestation (94532, Neza Bloodsnout) and Bristle Hills Bandits (94535, Kreza Darkthorn) are level 38 but need A Hunter's Quiver (96109, level 40).
Pack 07 turns 96109 in and then does both quests on balanced and speedrun. Both routes pick them up at Rog'mar right after 96109 is handed in. Balanced does them on the Snargl's Snout trip to the
Bristle Hills and hands in with it. Speedrun skips Snargl, so it kills the gnolls during the nearby Clear 'em Out / Proof of Profit stop and hands in at Rog'mar
before the Krol'dok step and the flight out (separate step ids `c/t94532-speedrun`, `c/t94535-speedrun`). Ids, givers and coordinates are from
`content/questie-db`; all six step kinds are `tags.forever` and `verified: false`.

### Quests above 40 handed over from the 20-40 route

The 20-40 route keeps only quests of level 40 and below; this route owns everything above 40. Added here (prerequisites at 40 or below are assumed done in 20-40 and named in a step note):
- Both routes: 576 Keep An Eye Out, 587 Up to Snuff (Booty Bay, during the Bloodsail chain), 592 Saving Yenniku (Grom'gol, after 591).
- Balanced only: 519/520/521 The Crown of Will (521 is handed in at Undercity on the way to Dustwallow), 507 Lord Aliden Perenolde, 643/644/645/646 Arathi sigils and Trol'kalar,
  652 Breaking the Keystone, 600 Venture Company Mining, 606/607/609 MacKinley's chain, 593 Filling the Soul Gem, 1372/1383 Nothing But The Truth (Duskwood edge via Deadwind Pass),
  and the missing objective and hand-in steps for 209 Skullsplitter Tusks, 598 Split Bone Necklace and 608 The Bloodsail Buccaneers (only the pick-ups were here before).
- Deliberately dropped (not on either route):
  - 594 Message in a Bottle: starts from a random item drop (Carefully Folded Note), so it cannot be scheduled.
  - 624 and 625 Cortello's Riddle: start from a random drop and send you across three zones for a small reward.
  - 1205 Deadmire: given and handed in by Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff, a round trip the route never makes; the target is an elite crocolisk.
  - 97332 Twice Misplaced Trust: picked up in Booty Bay but handed in at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades; the route has left the Riverglades for good by the time
    it reaches Booty Bay on its way back, and the 20-40 route stops at level 40.
- Added later: 508 Taretha's Gift (balanced, right after 507; given by Elysa in Alterac, handed in to Krusk at Tarren Mill).
- Dungeon lead-ins: the Krol'dok lead-ins 94768 (Bring Me His Head, for 94975) and 95278 (It Is Time, Brother..., for 94968 and 94972) are already on the balanced route before
  the Krol'dok placeholder. Not added on speedrun: 94768 is an elite group quest. 95770 (Drowned City lead-in) stays in the 20-40 route.

## Conventions and caveats

- Coordinates are zone % from QuestieDB Forever (Forever map transforms applied). `mapId` is the UiMap id. Riverglades = 2548 and Mount Hyjal = 2482 come from QuestieDB's Forever DBC notes.
- **`forever` flag:** schema v2 has no `forever` field, so WoW Forever-new steps use `tags.forever = true` (637 steps). Any step that uses a quest with
  `forever: true` in PR #5 is `verified: false`, and so is everything nested in it (pins, tips). Quest ids, givers, turn-ins and coordinates for these steps come from
  PR #5 (QuestieDB v1.1.3 Forever build); Riverglades/Hyjal travel notes still cite the fan sites listed in SOURCES.md.
- Riverglades quests below 40 and Shen'dralas' Desolace start are left to the 20-40 research. Steps that need one of them say so in a note.
- Quests with prerequisites in the 30-40 bracket (Nesingwary tiers, Bloodscalp, Split Bone Necklace) carry a warning line naming the earlier quest ids.
- 30 `complete` steps have no objective coordinates in QuestieDB (escorts, used-item objectives, scripted spawns). They still have a goto at the quest area where one exists.
- Role tips on kill/collect steps are generic per role. Class-specific advice is in `tipsMatrix`, and per-zone speed tips sit on the first step of each zone.
- Classic quests may have changed in WoW Forever. QA should spot-check in game, especially Eastern Plaguelands, whose map was rescaled.
